notes: Hypotheses are player constructions; the engine only grades them against real state (insights, collected evidence, learned facts, drawn board contradictions). Accusations are always speakable; the TIER decides which data-declared consequences land. ACC-COLES-RING is repeatable by declaration: the baseless whisper spreads first, the confession-grounded accusation can follow later and lands harder. Every entry carries a canon_ref - nothing here invents plot. Tier consequences are believable costs, never soft-locks: the Q-S-C3-SHONI alibi routes and FLG_SHONI_FREED/JAILED stay owned by the quest system (QUEST_ARCHITECTURE 3 C3).

hypotheses.title: The Hunger came back for the miller
hypotheses.method: The old devourer of 1839 woke again and took Tobias Nott where he stood, salt and all.
hypotheses.motive: None needed - hunger needs no reason. (The village's own reading of the deaths.)

refuted_by.reason: A refused sin-dish and a salt-packed mouth do not answer to a ghost - the board marks the Hunger claim against the physical record.
The wheel-race prints were made of flesh: bare feet, small, walking out of the race. The Hunger leaves no prints.

hypotheses.canon_ref: evidence_slice EVD-COLES-HUNGER ('Folk fear, not fact') + QUEST_ARCHITECTURE.md 2.2 (wrong logical links are marked as contradictions with a stated reason)

hypotheses.title: The registered-sin pattern: the miller's fraud was real
hypotheses.method: The hollowed weights show the sin; the restored list shows the registration; the deaths follow the registered sins of 1839 - Nott's was first in, first answered.
hypotheses.motive: The orphan's bread, taken across years - a debt the pattern collects.
hypotheses.canon_ref: CHARACTER_REGISTRY.md CHR-15 + insight INS-PATTERN ('The First Death Follows a Registered Sin', evidence_slice) + QUEST_ARCHITECTURE.md 3 C2 (FLG_CASE_OPENED, FLG_SIN_LIST_KNOWN)

hypotheses.title: The tinker killed the miller for the salt
hypotheses.method: A road-knife, a missing sack, a man who was on the moor road that night - the county's theory, retold at every hearth.
hypotheses.motive: Salt is money in a hunger winter.

refuted_by.reason: The physical record answers the county's shortcut: the prints and the salt on the mill floor fit no road-thief's hurry.
The hill-road account puts Shoni above the valley while the miller died below it.

hypotheses.canon_ref: QUEST_ARCHITECTURE.md 3 C3 (the county's theory: 'the tinker did it, and the village repeats it') + quest Q-S-C3-SHONI (the alibi branches) + CHARACTER_REGISTRY.md CHR-14 (the accidental witness of 1839)

on_baseless.journal_note: I put the county's words on Shoni Gwyn, out loud, in the square. The square heard it. The square will remember it longer than the county will.

accusations.canon_ref: QUEST_ARCHITECTURE.md 3 C3 (the county's theory) + CHARACTER_REGISTRY.md CHR-14 (the accidental witness - innocent; FLG_SHONI_FREED/JAILED stay quest-owned)

on_grounded.journal_note: I named Tobias Nott's sin from the restored list, with the weights on the table to prove it. Pritchard wrote it down like a man handed a map.

on_partial.journal_note: I spoke of Nott's fraud with the case half-built. Half a case buys half a hearth's belief.

on_baseless.journal_note: I named a dead man's sins with nothing in my hand. The square decided enough grief had been done to the Notts.

accusations.canon_ref: QUEST_ARCHITECTURE.md 2.1 (the E1 bar: a case file whose evidence is mostly reliability >= 0.7) + CHARACTER_REGISTRY.md CHR-15 + evidence EVD-SINLIST / EVD-SCALE-WEIGHTS

on_grounded.journal_note: I spent his confession in the open, and the square got a show and a shamed gravedigger. Coles looked at me the way men look at returned letters. He will not speak gently again.

on_partial.journal_note: Word of the ring reached Coles before any proof did. His spade kept its rhythm. His answers will not.

on_baseless.journal_note: I spoke of a ring I could not name. Coles' spade kept its rhythm. His eyes did not.

accusations.canon_ref: CHARACTER_REGISTRY.md CHR-13 (the 1831 ring) + QUEST_ARCHITECTURE.md Q-S04 (the ring returns through kindness, not the square)

on_partial.journal_note: I put the sermon to him with the pattern beside it. He did not break - he preached. But the words cost him something, and I watched it leave.

on_baseless.journal_note: I accused the church of the mill with no ledger in hand. Crane forgave me out loud, which was worse.

accusations.canon_ref: CHARACTER_REGISTRY.md CHR-04 (the sermon's true motive is tangled with fame; the real confrontation lands at C6 with FLG_CRANE_BROKEN / FLG_CRANE_FANATIC - the slice caps this at partial by design)
